Job Description
Join 3C Metal: A Global Leader in Turnkey Project Solutions
Established in 1995, 3C Metal Group started as a specialist in high-pressure piping, welding, and installation services for the oil and gas sector. Over the years, the company has diversified its expertise into renewable energy, green technology, power generation, marine, and mining industries. Today 3C Metal Group is present in nine countries, across four continents and has a workforce of 1000 employees. In 2024, 3C Metal Group joined the Ortec Group, further enhancing our capabilities and expanding our global presence.
Today, 3C Metal operates in nine countries across four continents with a workforce of over 1,000 employees. In 2024, we joined the Ortec Group, further enhancing our capabilities and expanding our global footprint. As part of this expansion, we have recently established a new entity in Türkiye, marking a key step in our regional growth strategy. Headquartered in Istanbul, this entity will support the delivery of energy and industrial infrastructure projects across Türkiye and the wider region.
Why Choose 3C Metal?
Global footprint: Originating in France, 3C Metal has expanded its presence to the USA, Namibia, South Africa, Mozambique, the UAE, and Malaysia, offering a truly international experience.
Innovation & Expertise: We pride ourselves on our ability to deliver exceptional results through cutting-edge technologies, design solutions, and world-class project management.
Responsibilities
As a member of our Projects Team, you will play a crucial role in developing our activities in Türkiye by ensuring the successful delivery of engineering solutions for complex projects. Your responsibilities will include:
Participating in project kick-off meetings and technical surveys (onshore/offshore)
Preparing bids and client offers, including estimation and supplier coordination
Supporting project execution through planning, scheduling, and client follow-up
Coordinating engineering deliverables and ensuring timely drawing issuance
Managing procurement, prefabrication, and logistics in line with project needs
Overseeing installation phases, including team mobilization and site support
Leading project close-out activities, including profitability analysis and documentation
Profile
Educational Background
We seek the ideal candidate profile with:
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering
Languages
Fluent in both English and Turkish.
Industry Knowledge
Minimum 2 years of experience in engineering project execution, preferably in the oil and gas sector
Familiarity with high-pressure piping systems and steel fabrication
Essential Technical Skills
Strong understanding of welding processes (GTAW, SMAW, FCAW)
Knowledge of standards such as ASME B31.3, API, ASME IX, AWS D1.1
Experience with project planning, estimation, and execution cycles
Software Proficiency
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
Familiarity with project scheduling tools (e.g., MS Project or equivalent)
Diversity & Inclusion
3C Metal is dedicated to cultivating an inclusive workplace that celebrates diversity. We are committed to ensuring all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities to grow their skills and talents. Operating across eight countries, we draw strength from the diversity of our workforce, embracing the unique insights and perspectives that our global presence brings.
